interface.title: CAR-T Oncology Trials Monitor — CAR-T & Cell Therapies in Oncology (Heme and Solid Tumors)
interface.field: Clinical oncology / cell-therapy translational research (CAR-T, CAR-NK, CAAR-T, CAR-γδ T clinical trial landscape)
interface.stage_of_work: Landscape survey and evidence synthesis, from exploring a registry-derived trial dataset through to publication figures and provenance-tagged data exports
interface.what_it_is_for: Filter a classified dataset of CAR-based oncology trials from ClinicalTrials.gov by disease hierarchy, target, phase and geography, drill into single trials, targets, products and competitive landscapes, and export citable figures and CSVs.

data.note: The live ClinicalTrials.gov fetch failed after 4 retries (no network), and the app fell back to the bundled frozen snapshot 2026-10-29 with 2,320 trials (screens/007.webp). I then pinned the older bundled snapshot 2026-10-24 with 2,315 trials (screens/024.webp) and used it for everything else. While unpinned, every change re-ran the failing live fetch, which took about 20–30 s each time (screens/013.webp, screens/016.webp).

features.name: Dated dataset pinning for reproducibility
features.general: Choose a dated, frozen version of a dataset that updates over time, lock the session to it, and see which version is active, with a way back to live data
features.specific: Reproducibility expander: pick a snapshot date, press 'Pin snapshot <date>', see the 'Pinned to frozen snapshot 2026-10-24 (2,315 trials)' banner, 'Unpin — switch back to live data'; exports record the pinned snapshot
steps: open the Reproducibility expander
choose a dated snapshot from the dropdown
press 'Pin snapshot <date>'
check the pinned banner and trial count
optionally unpin to return to live data
serves_tasks: Choose and lock a dated version of the dataset
Export the current slice with provenance

features.name: Cascading hierarchical multi-select filter
features.general: Filter records through a three-level hierarchy, where picking parent levels limits the child options, and every view updates
features.specific: Sidebar Branch → Disease category → Disease entity multiselects; picking Solid-onc limits categories to solid ones, and picking GI limits entities to GI ones; KPI tiles and all tabs update (2,315 → 634 → 153)
steps: clear the top-level selection
pick a branch
clear and pick a category from the narrowed list
review the narrowed entity list and the updated counts
serves_tasks: Narrow records through a three-level hierarchy
